title: Decision rights
description: Who may decide what (EE-017). The template lives at governance/venture-template/decision-rights.json; a venture may tighten a class (move it to a higher level or a more senior owner) in <venture>/governance/decision-rights.json, and loosening one needs an owner decision. Levels follow RAPID and DACI: decide, decide-inform, recommend-approve, escalate.

template.description: True for the template; a venture's file omits it or sets false

extends.description: A venture file: path to the template it tightens

owner.description: Role id from the roles register

decision.description: A venture file: the decision that tightened or loosened it
